# Numbers of ParlPDFeCH, track 2A

Made: 14.10.2026 15:01 CEST (time from the clock). Tool: `src/m11_numbers.py` of the private project.

Status of each value: EXCEPTION, NOT RELEASED. No human checked a value of this file.

Written in English to the STE rules (ASD-STE100, Issue 9). An AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5) wrote the tool and this file.

## 1 How to read this file

1. This file shows the content of `numbers.json` as tables. The two files hold the same values.
2. The report, the README and the website must take each number from `numbers.json`. A later tool checks this.
3. The tool reads each value from its source file. No value is typed by hand.
4. The column Value shows the display form. The stored text of each value is in `numbers.json`.
5. In the groups 2.1 to 2.14, each accuracy compares a method with the AI reference E20 v4.1. It is not a comparison with a human label.
6. The tool read aggregate records only. It read no value of a single validation document.
7. No value comes from the content of a document of the test set.
8. Paths are files of the private project. The table of chapter 3 gives the SHA-256 of each file.
9. In `numbers.json`, the field `value` is the text of the source. A value from a text can hold a thousands comma. The field `value_plain` has no comma.
10. The group Values from the PDF compares a value from the PDF with the OpenParlData export. No human of the project examined the export values.
11. The words (after the opening) in the column Set show a run after the opening of the closed part. The rules of such a run were changed with knowledge of all development parliaments.
12. The value `not measured yet` shows an entry whose source file is not on disk. Such an entry has no value.
13. A text can state a second calculation for a value only if this file says `yes, compared`.
14. Round 4 (ids `values.round4.*`) is the product state: the rule files come from the PDF alone.
15. Round 3 (ids `values.round3.*`) is the earlier state: rule files with 3 export fields.
16. The words (after the design values of addendum I) in the column Set show a value of the heads design.
17. Each head value of that design is out-of-fold on development documents. Such a value is optimistic.
18. The ids `values.last_run.*` are the place of the one last run on 872 documents. That run is the measurement.
19. The ids `values.last_run.spread.*` come from a file that was made after the one last run. They are information, not a measure of addendum I.
20. The ids `values.last_run.contact.*` count id lists of earlier work. Such a count is not a count of the contact of an AI agent with a document.
21. `sets.parliaments.validation` counts the parliaments of the 44 labelled validation documents. `values.last_run.parliaments.validation` counts the parliaments of the one last run.

Marks of the column Mark:

| Mark | Meaning |
|---|---|
| measured | A project script wrote the value into the source file. |
| read | The value was read in a document (criteria file, addendum, state file of the package, cascade file). |
| protocol only | The value exists only in the text of the protocol. The key names the row. |
| estimate | The source gives the value as an estimate. |
| derived | The tool calculated the value from other entries, or it counted the items of a source key. |
| reading check | An AI agent judged the value against the printed text of 50 documents. It is not the measurement. |

Values of the column Second calculation:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| yes, compared | The tool read the value of the second calculation and found it equal in the tolerance. |
| yes, record | A record of a second calculation exists for the run. The tool did not compare the single value. |
| yes, protocol | Only a protocol row states the second calculation. |
| no | The tool knows no record of a second calculation. |

An AI agent made each second calculation. No second calculation is a check by a human.

Counts of this file: 3140 entries. By mark: derived 268, estimate 2, measured 2469, protocol only 44, read 112, reading check 245.

Entries with the status `not measured yet`: 0. Entries with the mark of a run after the opening: 600. Entries with the mark of the heads design: 225.

The protocol, the state file of the package and 2 code files of the fixed numbers change often. Thus the SHA-256 of the whole file changes.
For a value from these files, `numbers.json` holds the SHA-256 of the one line with the value.

## 4 Limits of this file

1. The block-role candidates B1-S and B1-L have no run on group 7. The one last run (ids `values.last_run.*`) holds values of group 7.
2. No record of the test set was scored with the new converter.
3. The calibration target GJ.13 has the result NOT MET for each of the 3 variants.
4. The validation values of B1-S and B1-L come from run 2 and run 3 on the same 44 documents.
5. The tool knows no record of a second calculation for the head design of 12.10.
6. The second calculation of the B1-L design compared the design record of 10:36. The validation run used the record of 10:53.
7. The values of the package are from one run each on one Mac. No container was built.
8. A value with the mark protocol only has no aggregate file that this tool can read.
9. The reference of the group Values from the PDF is the OpenParlData export. An export value can be wrong or can have another form than the printed text.
10. The Jeffreys interval of a value from the PDF does not include the effect of the parliaments.
11. The closed part was opened one time. Each value of round 3, of round 4 and of the heads design is from a run after that opening.
12. The reading check is the judgement of an AI agent on 50 documents. No human made it.
13. The counts of the cascade are counts of a design file with the status PROPOSED, NOT RELEASED.
14. The tool expects the first tool file of the one last run at a fixed place. The key names come from `src/m11_heads2_last_measures.py`.
15. No tool run read that file at the time when the key names were set. A wrong key name stops the build.
16. The export has no field for the kind of a document. Thus the counts of the kind and of rule V5 have no reference.
17. The tool knows no record of a second calculation for the heads design.
18. Of the values file of round 4 the tool reads the run record only (key `header`).
